text:
### Intake Process  
**Upon Fraud Allegation:**  
**Step 1: Initial Report**  
```
Fraud Report Form:
- Fraud ID: FRAUD-[DATE]-[001-999] (e.g., FRAUD-2026-0115-001)
- Report Date: [Date/Time]
- Reporter: [Name, Department, Phone]
- Reporter Category: [Customer / Staff / System / Law Enforcement]

Alleged Fraud Details:
- Customer Name & Account: [ACC-XXXXX]
- Transaction(s) in Question: [List with dates, amounts]
- Alleged Fraudster Identity (if known): [Description]
- Fraud Type: [Account Takeover / Unauthorized Transaction / Other]
- Alleged Loss Amount: [£Amount]
- Report Urgency: [Routine / Urgent / Critical]
```  
**Step 2: Initial Triage**  
```
Is This Urgent?
☐ YES → Immediate action required (within 1 hour)
- Account takeover in progress
- Large amount in immediate danger
- Law enforcement/critical incident

☐ NO → Standard investigation (within 24 hours)
- Disputed transaction already posted
- Customer noticed but no immediate threat
- Routine investigation
```  
**Step 3: Account Security Actions** (if urgent)  
```
IMMEDIATE ACTIONS (First 5 Minutes):
- [ ] Freeze customer account (block transactions)
- [ ] Block customer's debit/credit cards (prevent further fraud)
- [ ] Reset customer's online banking password
- [ ] Log customer out of all sessions
- [ ] Document actions taken & time
- [ ] Notify customer (by phone if possible)
- [ ] Escalate to Financial Crime Head if >£5,000
```

raw_entities.name: Fraud Intake Process
raw_entities.description: End-to-end procedure for receiving, triaging, and initiating response to fraud allegations. Begins with formal fraud report submission and includes urgency classification to determine investigation timeline and immediate account security actions.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Report Submission
raw_entities.description: Formal capture of fraud allegation details using standardized Fraud Report Form. Collects reporter identity and category, customer and account information, transaction details, alleged fraudster description, fraud type classification, loss amount, and urgency level.
context: Reporter Category: [Customer / Staff / System / Law Enforcement]

raw_entities.name: Fraud Urgency Triage
raw_entities.description: Classification of fraud report as Urgent or Routine based on threat indicators. Urgent cases require action within 1 hour and include account takeover in progress, large amounts in immediate danger, or law enforcement involvement. Routine cases proceed within 24 hours.

raw_entities.name: Account Security Lockdown
raw_entities.description: Immediate protective actions executed within first 5 minutes of urgent fraud cases to prevent further unauthorized activity. Includes account freeze, card blocking, password reset, session termination, action documentation, customer notification, and escalation trigger for high-value cases.
context: Block customer's debit/credit cards (prevent further fraud)

raw_entities.name: Fraud Urgency Gate
raw_entities.description: Binary decision point determining investigation timeline and response intensity. YES path triggers immediate 1-hour response with account security lockdown. NO path routes to standard 24-hour investigation.

raw_entities.name: High-Value Fraud Escalation Trigger
raw_entities.description: Escalation gate triggered when alleged fraud loss exceeds £5,000 threshold. Cases meeting this threshold are escalated to Financial Crime Head for senior oversight.
context: Escalate to Financial Crime Head if >£5,000

raw_entities.name: Fraud Report Submitter
raw_entities.description: Any party initiating a fraud report, including customers, bank staff, automated systems, or law enforcement. Captured with name, department, and contact phone in the Fraud Report Form.
context: Reporter Category: [Customer / Staff / System / Law Enforcement]

raw_entities.name: Fraud Triage Analyst
raw_entities.description: Operations staff member responsible for executing Initial Triage step, classifying fraud reports as Urgent or Routine based on defined threat indicators.

raw_entities.name: Account Security Response Team
raw_entities.description: Operations team executing immediate account security actions in urgent fraud cases, including account freeze, card blocking, password reset, session termination, and customer notification within the first 5 minutes.
context: Block customer's debit/credit cards (prevent further fraud)

raw_entities.name: Financial Crime Head
raw_entities.description: Senior leadership role responsible for escalation and oversight of high-value fraud cases exceeding £5,000 threshold.
context: Escalate to Financial Crime Head if >£5,000

raw_entities.name: Fraud Allegation
raw_entities.description: Formal fraud allegation received through standardized intake process. Assigned unique Fraud ID with date and sequence number. Triggers triage, investigation, and potential account security response based on urgency classification.
context: Fraud Type: [Account Takeover / Unauthorized Transaction / Other]

raw_entities.name: Account Takeover Fraud
raw_entities.description: Fraud type classification indicating unauthorized access and control of customer account. Classified as urgent trigger requiring immediate 1-hour response and account security lockdown.
context: Fraud Type: [Account Takeover / Unauthorized Transaction / Other]

raw_entities.name: Unauthorized Transaction Fraud
raw_entities.description: Fraud type classification indicating unauthorized transaction(s) on customer account. May be classified as Routine if transaction already posted and no immediate threat exists.
context: Fraud Type: [Account Takeover / Unauthorized Transaction / Other]

raw_entities.name: Customer Account
raw_entities.description: Customer account subject to fraud allegation. Identified by account number in format ACC-XXXXX. May be frozen and have associated cards blocked during urgent fraud response.

raw_entities.name: Customer Debit Card
raw_entities.description: Debit card associated with customer account. Blocked immediately in urgent fraud cases to prevent further unauthorized transactions.
context: Block customer's debit/credit cards (prevent further fraud)

raw_entities.name: Customer Credit Card
raw_entities.description: Credit card associated with customer account. Blocked immediately in urgent fraud cases to prevent further unauthorized transactions.
context: Block customer's debit/credit cards (prevent further fraud)

raw_entities.name: Fraud Allegation Customer
raw_entities.description: Individual customer whose account is subject to fraud allegation. Receives notification by phone during urgent fraud response and has account security actions taken on their behalf.

raw_entities.name: Disputed Transaction
raw_entities.description: Financial transaction(s) alleged to be fraudulent. Captured with transaction date and amount in fraud report. May already be posted to account or represent imminent threat depending on urgency classification.
context: Transaction(s) in Question: [List with dates, amounts]

properties.outcome_failure: Fraud case not escalated; customer account remains at risk; unauthorized transactions continue

properties.path_no: Standard investigation within 24 hours; route to routine investigation queue

properties.path_yes: Escalate immediately to Financial Crime Head
